ashley (product): @here Quick GA update — Hosted Fleet (unified model + tool integrations) is GA starting today. Rolling regional activation over the next 72 hours. :tada:
ashley (product): TL;DR: new unified endpoints (/v2/generate and /v2/chat), two new fleet models (fleet-lowlatency, fleet-cost), streaming perf improvements (~30% chunk latency), and the first-stable unified tool-integration layer (function/tool routing v1). Docs + migration guide linked below.
ashley (product): Policy change: legacy /v1 endpoints will be supported for 180 days. We recommend migrating to /v2 within 60 days to get routing, batching, and cost controls. Paid accounts get configurable rate limits; free tier limits are adjusted (see FAQ).
ashley (product): Migration helpers: Console -> Projects -> Migrate endpoint provides auto-redirects, test traffic, and a dry-run compatibility checker. There is also a CLI flag --migrate-to-v2 in the redwoodctl v0.9.
tariq (eng): Huge work by eng — infra rollout starts this evening for hosted. Dedicated customers: we'll contact account owners separately with a precise migration slot.
marco (infra): deploy-bot triggered canary today 18:00 UTC. I'll post the rollout playbook and escalation steps in the #eng-oncall channel.
deploy-bot: release hosted-control-plane v2.3.1 deployed to canary clusters (tag: rwd/fleet-ga-2023).
jen (sre): Monitoring update: new dashboards (API /v2 latency, tool-route error rates) are live. Alerts: critical if 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 5m. I pushed a dashboard link to the ops playbook.
devin (docs): Docs PR: https://docs.redwood.example/r/2023/fleet-ga — migration guide, API samples, and code snippets added. Will push example repos for node/python shortly.
ashley (product): We'll host a town-hall Q&A tomorrow 10:00am PT (calendar invite out). Agenda: migration timeline, rate-limit policy, canary results, and enterprise migration paths.
ops-oncall: Note — if customers hit throttles after migration, enable project fallback-policy to route to compatible model variant automatically.
marco (infra): For customers on Dedicated, we'll open maintenance windows; expect brief rolling restarts (no data loss). Contact infra@redwood.com to request a custom migration slot.
tariq (eng): Internal ask for teams: update any internal infra that parses /v1 request payloads (small schema changes for tool-params). Compat checker will flag issues but please run locally.
ashley (product): Sorry for the long thread. Short links: Announcement page: <https://redwood.in/announce/fleet-ga>, Migration guide: <https://redwood.in/migrate/v1-to-v2>, FAQ: <https://redwood.in/faq/fleet-ga>.
ashley (product): Again — congrats to everyone. This stabilizes a lot of customer pain points (latency + costs). :clap: :shipit:
devin (docs): will follow up with a docs highlight thread and example PRs in #devex.
jen (sre): tagging oncall: if you see anything weird overnight ping me directly.
marco (infra): +1, will keep rollback playbook ready.
ashley (product): If customers ask about pricing changes: there are no surprise spikes — quantized fleet variants reduce per-token cost, routing may favor cheaper variants unless pinned. Finance + Sales will post a short FAQ.
ops-oncall: FYI — enterprise customers with strict egress must confirm tool-routing consent; we'll surface config in Console.
ashely (typo-test): (ignore me)
ashley (product): (lol) editing note: if you see the stray message above ignore it.
ashley (product): Closing: please read the migration guide and join the Q&A if you manage integrations. :eyes:
